name: Bleed
terse: You have suffered wounds deep enough that you are now bleeding out, you must do something.
effects:
Only biological entities can suffer from this Status.

The Target takes 1d3-1 Kinetic damage at the start of their turn until they or an adjacent ally of the Target successfully pass a Patch or similar skill check.

name: Poison
terse: You have taken something into your body either knowingly or unknowingly and now the rejection is happening.
effects:
Only biological entities can suffer from this Status.

The Target has their maximum HP halved, rounded down. Additionally, the Target takes 1 Kinetic damage at the start of their turn unless they are at 1 HP.
This effect persists until the Target or an adjacent ally of the Target successfully pass a Patch or similar skill check.

name: Pathoparalysis
terse: Something feels off, something is trying to take you over.
effects:
Only biological entities can suffer from this Status.

At the start of each turn, the Target must make a Patch or similar skill check. So long as this check keeps passing, nothing happens.
Once the check fails, the Target immediately becomes Immobilized and Impaired. Now at the start of each turn, the Target or an adjacent ally to the target must pass a Patch or similar skill check or the Target will remain Immobilized and Impaired for the turn. Once this check passes, this status is removed.

name: Play Thing
terse: A disturbing presence nags at you. Your being targeted, your being hunted, you are being played with.
effects:
When you first gain this Status, you will have a +1 Difficulty to all attack rolls. For every attack you make, this Difficulty increases by +1 up to a maximum of +5. Every turn you take where you do not attack, the Difficulty goes down by 1 (-1) down to a minimum of +1.

This Status is removed upon death of you or whoever gave this Status.
